limitations: One reminder journal ID, one explicit owner discard, one concurrent confirming readback and atomic host compare-and-set storage. The action projection has one already admitted external effect that may appear before or after forgetting.

Discard is local journal removal after a host warning, not cancellation or a receipt of an external outcome. Confirmed creations remain retained, including a stale absent read followed by a newer found row. Changes after the final read are refused by the host compare-and-set.

Host authentication, the warning UI and explicit owner consent are assumptions outside this library. Durable host store implementation, failed or lost storage acknowledgements, multiple IDs, full-journal trimming, clock and schedule behavior, process death and real native reminder delivery are outside the finite model. Implementation conformance uses the actual journal with controlled storage/readback ports; it is not physical-device qualification.
